_README: Specimen-level corrections, keyed by Numista N# number.
Everything else on this site comes from the Numista catalogue, which describes
the coin TYPE. This file records where the specimen actually in the collection
differs from that type — a restrike, a replica, a different alloy, a known
counterfeit. Without it the site would present catalogue figures as though they
described the piece in hand, which for a restrike is simply wrong.
restrike           true  -> card shows a RESTRIKE mark and stops presenting
catalogue specs as this specimen's own
replica            true  -> same treatment, worded as a replica/copy
note               string, shown on the card. Say what is known, not what is guessed.
composition        string, overrides the catalogue composition when the real
alloy of this specimen is known
compositionUnknown true  -> suppress the composition chip rather than assert
a figure that does not describe this piece

26474.note: This piece is a restrike, not an original 1901 striking, and is not silver. The catalogue weight and diameter below describe the original type; the alloy of this specimen has not been recorded.
